title: Availability
description: When customers can book. Opening hours apply to everyone; team members can follow them or have their own schedule within them.

weekly.title: Opening hours
weekly.description: Your regular weekly hours. Add a second time range for a lunch break or split shift.
weekly.staffDescription: Their bookable hours each week (always within business opening hours).
weekly.followsBody: {name} is bookable whenever the business is open. Give them their own schedule if they work fewer hours.
weekly.followsNote: Start from the business hours and adjust. Hours outside business opening hours won’t be bookable.
weekly.endAfterStart: End time must be after start time.

closures.title: Holidays & closures
closures.description: Whole days you’re closed. Recurring holidays repeat every year.
closures.label: Label

special.title: Special opening hours
special.description: Different hours on a specific date, like a late opening or a short day.

blocks.title: Blocked time
blocks.description: Block part of a day for a meeting, an errand or a delivery. Existing bookings aren’t affected.
